---
title: Welcome to the Quarto visual editor
subtitle: A short tour. Edit anything on this page.
---

This page is a Quarto document, and you are editing it. Everything you type is saved as you go, and anyone you share this page's address with can edit it with you, live.

## Formatting text

Select some text and use the toolbar, or a shortcut: **bold** with ⌘B, *italic* with ⌘I, [underline]{.underline} with ⌘U, [highlight]{.mark} with ⇧⌘H, ~~strikethrough~~ with ⇧⌘X, and `code` with ⌘E. On Windows and Linux, use Ctrl instead of ⌘.

You can also type the markdown: `**bold**`, `*italic*` or a pair of backticks turn into formatting as you finish them.

## Links

Select some words and press ⌘K to make them a [link](https://quarto.org). Put the caret in a link to see where it goes, and to edit or remove it. Press Tab to reach its buttons from the keyboard.

You can also type the markdown: `[text](https://quarto.org)` turns into a link as you finish it.

## Headings, lists and quotes

Use the style box at the left of the toolbar to make a line a heading, or ⌥⌘1 to ⌥⌘4.

* The list buttons make bulleted lists, ⇧⌘8,
* and numbered ones, ⇧⌘7.

> The quote button, or ⇧⌘9, quotes a paragraph.

## Figures

An image on a line of its own is a figure, with its caption under it. Figures can't be edited here yet: change one in the source.

![A *test* caption](https://quarto.org/quarto.png){width=40%}

## Under the hood

The page is the same document as its qmd source. The Show source button at the right end of the toolbar shows that source next to the editor: edit either one, and the other follows.
